title: Black leggings gym outfit reference
description: Gym outfit reference showing black athletic leggings, a turquoise T-shirt and white trainers.
prompt: Create a dynamic sports-themed image featuring a female athlete in a modern gym setting, captured from a heroic low angle perspective. The athlete is wearing a sleek turquoise athletic ensemble, showcasing her fitness attire, which includes a sports bra and high-waisted leggings. She has her hair pulled back into a tight ponytail, with a determined look on her face as she flexes her muscles, embodying the essence of "Unleash Your Inner Champion." The gym environment should be well-lit with natural light, highlighting the athlete's form and the vibrant turquoise color palette. The background features modern fitness equipment, emphasizing the theme of sports and fitness. Technical quality terms such as crisp lighting and sharp focus are essential to bring out the details and intensity in the image.

title: Glamour Under the Spotlight
description: Sydney Sweeney shines in retro athletic chic at a red carpet event, exuding calm confidence with a slight smile against a sleek backdrop.
prompt: Sydney Sweeney, a young woman with blonde hair and light makeup, is captured in a glamorous pose against a sleek black background with white sponsor logos. She's wearing a vibrant red crop top and high-waisted shorts, embodying a retro athletic chic style. Her calm expression adds warmth and approachability to the portrait. The lighting is even, highlighting her features without being harsh, and her pose is straightforward yet effective, inviting interaction with the viewer. The image is a medium shot, capturing her from mid-thigh up, allowing both her attire and expression to be clearly visible.

title: Munting Pag-asa — original Filipino poetry infographic
description: An original Filipino poem illustrated through sunrise, seed, care and growth.
prompt:
Create a watercolor Filipino poetry infographic on warm paper. Title MUNTING PAG-ASA, subtitle Isang orihinal na tula. Render exactly:
Sa bawat umaga, may bagong liwanag.
Sa munting binhi, may buhay na taglay.
Diligan ng tiyaga, alagaan ng saya.
Sa tamang panahon, sisibol ang pag-asa.
Four illustrated panels labeled Liwanag, Binhi, Pag-aalaga, Pag-asa. Footer: Tema: Pag-asa at pagtitiyaga. Larawan: Ang binhi bilang simbolo ng pangarap. Filipino poetry • Original example. No attribution to an existing poet.
